{{Quote|A ''thousand Novian rubies'' to the man who brings me the ''girl!''<nowiki />|Krag orders his men|<ref name="e2" />}}
'''Novian rubies''' were a form of [[Currency/Legends|currency]]<ref name="e2" /> from the [[Novi system/Legends|Novi system]]<ref name="e2" /><ref name="Planetnamia" /> used by the [[Zorbian space pirates]].<ref name="e2" /> In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="E2Date">{{InsiderCite|23|Star Wars Publications Timeline|''Star Wars'' Publications Timeline}} dates the events of the [[Star Wars: Ewoks (1985)|''Ewoks'']] [[Star Wars comic books|comic series]], which include the events of [[Ewoks (1985) 2|''Ewoks'' 2]], to three [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the events of [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']], which corresponds to [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]] according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> when the Zorbians invaded the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks']] [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]] on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]], the Ewok [[Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka/Legends|Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka]] bit the leader of the Zorbians, [[Krag (Zorbian)|Krag]], who angrily promised a thousand Novian [[Ruby/Legends|rubies]] to whoever brought him Kintaka.<ref name="e2" />

==Behind the scenes==
Novian rubies were mentioned in the [[Ewoks (1985) 2|second issue]] of the [[Star Wars: Ewoks (1985)|''Ewoks'']] [[Star Wars comic books|comic series]], which was written by [[David Manak]] and published by [[Marvel Comics]]<ref name="e2" /> on [[April 2]], [[1985]].<ref name="Age">{{BookCite|title=[[Marvel Age]]|number=Vol. 1 No. 27|publisher=[[Marvel Comics]] Group|date=[[June]] [[1985]]}}</ref>
